source.title: Palladium-catalyzed Buchwald–Hartwig Amination and Suzuki–Miyaura Cross-coupling Reaction of Aryl Mesylates

reaction.notes: Second step (amination) only: Pd(OAc)2/CM-Phos-catalyzed Buchwald–Hartwig amination of 4-(tert-butyl)phenyl mesylate with N-methylaniline in tert-butanol at 120 °C for 24 h under N2. Catalyst pre-activation in DCM/Et3N, then solvent removal prior to coupling.
reaction.tags: palladium; CM-Phos; aryl mesylate; Buchwald–Hartwig amination; tert-butanol; K2CO3; phenylboronic acid additive

conditions.atmosphere: N2; pre-activate Pd(OAc)2 with CM-Phos in DCM/Et3N; sealed Schlenk; oil bath
N2; after charging K2CO3, phenylboronic acid, mesylate, N-methylaniline and t-BuOH; stir 10 min at rt

quench: Cool to room temperature; transfer to separatory funnel.
Rinse reaction flask with ether (2 × 50 mL), brine (2 × 50 mL), water (50 mL), and ether (50 mL); add all rinses to funnel.
workup: Separate layers; extract aqueous with ether (2 × 50 mL).
Dry combined organics over Na2SO4 (5 g); filter; rinse Na2SO4 with ether (50 mL).
Concentrate on rotary evaporator (40 °C, 12 mmHg) to brown oil.

purification.stationary_phase: Silica gel (130 g; 4.5 cm ID × 16 cm packed height)
purification.eluent: Hexane (130 mL), then CH2Cl2/hexane (1:49) until product is eluted
purification.fractions: Collect 100 mL fractions; combine product fractions

notes: Product: 4-(tert-Butyl)-N-methyl-N-phenylaniline obtained as pale-yellow liquid, 3.60–3.85 g (86–92%).

original_procedure: In a resealable Schlenk flask under N2, Pd(OAc)2 (1.0 mol%) and CM‑Phos (4.0 mol%) are combined with DCM (18 mL) and Et3N (1.8 mL). After 5 min in a 50 °C oil bath, volatiles are removed (0.01 mmHg, 1 h). K2CO3 (2.5 equiv), phenylboronic acid (0.2 equiv), 4-(tert‑butyl)phenyl mesylate (1.0 equiv), N‑methylaniline (≈1.5 equiv), and tert‑butyl alcohol (70 mL) are added under N2. Stir 10 min at rt, then heat at 120 °C for 24 h. Work up by dilution/extraction, dry (Na2SO4), concentrate, and purify by silica gel chromatography (hexane then CH2Cl2/hexane 1:49) to afford the tertiary aniline.
